Four source files register a handler for `issue.created`. Each one calls `subscribe("issue.created", ...)` inside a `register*Listeners()` function, and `src/server/services/event-registry.ts` calls those functions at startup:

- `src/server/services/usage-service.ts` (`registerUsageListeners`, line 74) increments the org's issue usage count.
- `src/server/services/search-service.ts` (`registerSearchListeners`, line 139) loads the issue and indexes it.
- `src/server/services/activity-service.ts` (`registerActivityListeners`, line 169) records an `issue.created` audit row.
- `src/server/services/webhook-service.ts` (`registerWebhookListeners`, line 110) enqueues webhook deliveries for the org.

I excluded `src/server/services/issue-service.ts`, which publishes the event through `emit()` (line 71), and the declaration and label files (`src/types/event.ts`, `src/types/activity.ts`, `src/schemas/activity.ts`, `src/schemas/webhook.ts`, `src/components/domain/activity/activity-labels.ts`). `event-registry.ts` only wires the register functions and subscribes to `digest.due` itself. I also left out the test files.

ANSWER: src/server/services/usage-service.ts, src/server/services/search-service.ts, src/server/services/activity-service.ts, src/server/services/webhook-service.ts
